title: person-member-unlock-store — case shape (v0.2)
description: Pins the B2B member vault-unlock password KEK derivation (derive_person_vault_member_unlock_key: Argon2id over the password under the salt domain 'myne.v0.2 argon2id-person-vault-member-unlock|' with a per-device random salt and the vault account_number_hash in the domain scope) and the device-local vault.member-unlock AAD (aad_person_member_unlock_store: role 'person-member-unlock-store', vault_id || account_number_hash, v0.2 prefix). Both are cross-implementation contracts (decisions/protocol/0653).
